title: Linking Ideas with Precision: In order to, So that, Because of & Due to
objective: Menggabungkan ide kompleks menggunakan konjungsi tujuan dan penyebab formal untuk tulisan dan pidato yang koheren.

theory.summary: Dalam bahasa Inggris formal, kita menggunakan konjungsi khusus untuk menunjukkan tujuan dan penyebab dengan presisi. Konjungsi tujuan seperti 'in order to' dan 'so that' menjelaskan alasan melakukan sesuatu, sedangkan 'because of' dan 'due to' menunjukkan penyebab dari suatu situasi. Memahami perbedaan struktur gramatikal setelah setiap konjungsi ini sangat penting untuk menulis laporan, email profesional, dan pidato formal di level B1.
rules: IN ORDER TO + verb (infinitive): Digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan dengan struktur formal. Contoh: 'She studies every night in order to pass the exam.' (Subjek kedua klausa harus sama)

SO THAT + subject + modal verb (can/could/will/would): Digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan dengan penjelasan lebih lengkap. Contoh: 'He speaks slowly so that everyone can understand him.' (Bisa digunakan dengan subjek berbeda)

BECAUSE OF / DUE TO + noun phrase: Digunakan untuk menyatakan penyebab dengan kata benda atau frasa nomina. Contoh: 'The flight was cancelled due to bad weather.' atau 'She succeeded because of her hard work.'
BECAUSE + subject + verb (clause): Digunakan untuk menyatakan penyebab dengan klausa lengkap. Contoh: 'They arrived late because the traffic was heavy.' (Memerlukan subjek dan kata kerja)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Mencampur Struktur Noun Phrase dan Clause
commonTrap.explanation: Siswa level B1 sering salah menggunakan 'because of' diikuti klausa lengkap, atau 'because' diikuti noun phrase. Ingat: 'because of/due to' hanya diikuti kata benda atau frasa nomina, sedangkan 'because' harus diikuti subjek + kata kerja.
commonTrap.wrong: The meeting was postponed because of the manager was sick.
commonTrap.correct: The meeting was postponed because the manager was sick. ATAU The meeting was postponed because of the manager's illness.

vocab.collocation: We need precision in our measurements to ensure accurate results.
They decided to postpone the conference due to technical difficulties.
Please arrive early in order to ensure you get a good seat.
Due to unforeseen circumstances, we had to change our travel plans.
He worked overtime so that the project outcome would exceed expectations.
We couldn't hire more staff because of budget constraints.
The company will implement new policies in order to improve productivity.
Could you clarify that point so that we all understand the requirement?
The train service was affected due to a major disruption on the line.
We changed the meeting time in order to accommodate everyone's schedule.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Tom adalah rekan kerja yang sedang membahas persiapan presentasi penting untuk klien internasional. Mereka mendiskusikan alasan dan tujuan dari berbagai keputusan persiapan mereka.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Tom, I've prepared extra handouts so that all the participants can follow along easily during our presentation.
lines.translation: Tom, saya sudah menyiapkan handout tambahan agar semua peserta bisa mengikuti dengan mudah selama presentasi kita.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's excellent. I also arrived early in order to test all the equipment before the clients arrive.
lines.translation: Itu bagus sekali. Saya juga datang lebih awal untuk menguji semua peralatan sebelum klien datang.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Good thinking. Actually, we need to simplify slide 7 because of the feedback we received from the manager yesterday.
lines.translation: Pemikiran yang bagus. Sebenarnya, kita perlu menyederhanakan slide 7 karena masukan yang kita terima dari manajer kemarin.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I agree. The previous version was too technical. Should we include more examples so that the concepts are clearer?
lines.translation: Saya setuju. Versi sebelumnya terlalu teknis. Haruskah kita memasukkan lebih banyak contoh agar konsepnya lebih jelas?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Definitely. Also, the meeting room was changed due to renovation work on the third floor.
lines.translation: Tentu saja. Juga, ruang rapat diganti karena pekerjaan renovasi di lantai tiga.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Oh, I didn't know that. We're now in Conference Room B, right? I'll send an update email in order to inform everyone about the location change.
lines.translation: Oh, saya tidak tahu itu. Kita sekarang di Ruang Konferensi B, kan? Saya akan mengirim email pembaruan untuk menginformasikan semua orang tentang perubahan lokasi.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Perfect. Let's do a final run-through because we only have 30 minutes left before they arrive.
lines.translation: Sempurna. Mari kita lakukan latihan terakhir karena kita hanya punya waktu 30 menit lagi sebelum mereka tiba.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Agreed. I want everything to be perfect so that we can win this contract.
lines.translation: Setuju. Saya ingin semuanya sempurna agar kita bisa memenangkan kontrak ini.

speakingLab.context: Mr. Khoirul membantu Anda berlatih menggunakan konjungsi tujuan dan penyebab dalam konteks merencanakan acara kampus. Anda berperan sebagai panitia acara yang menjelaskan keputusan dan rencana Anda.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! I heard you're organizing the campus cultural festival. Can you tell me why you chose the main hall as the venue?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi Mr. Khoirul! We chose the main hall because of its large capacity. It can accommodate up to 500 people.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That makes sense. What about the date? I noticed you changed it from the original plan.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, we postponed it by one week due to the midterm examination schedule. We wanted to avoid conflicts with students' exams.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good decision. What preparations have you made so far?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: We've hired professional sound equipment in order to ensure the best audio quality for the performances. We also created a detailed program so that everyone knows the schedule.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent planning! Have you considered promoting the event?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, we're using social media extensively so that we can reach more students. We're also putting up posters because many students don't check social media regularly.

quiz.question: The company implemented new security measures ___ protect customer data more effectively.
quiz.explanation: 'In order to' adalah pilihan yang tepat karena diikuti oleh kata kerja infinitif 'protect'. Strukturnya: in order to + verb. 'So that' memerlukan subject + modal verb, dan 'because of' digunakan untuk menyatakan penyebab, bukan tujuan.

quiz.question: The flight was delayed ___ severe weather conditions at the destination airport.
quiz.explanation: 'Due to' benar karena diikuti noun phrase 'severe weather conditions'. 'Because' memerlukan klausa lengkap (subject + verb), sedangkan 'so that' digunakan untuk tujuan, bukan penyebab.

quiz.question: She speaks three languages fluently ___ she can communicate with international clients easily.
quiz.explanation: 'So that' benar karena diikuti klausa lengkap 'she can communicate...' dengan subject dan modal verb 'can'. Strukturnya: so that + subject + modal + verb. 'In order to' hanya diikuti verb infinitif, dan 'because of' untuk penyebab dengan noun phrase.

quiz.question: Many students failed the exam ___ they didn't study the recommended materials thoroughly.
quiz.explanation: 'Because' tepat karena diikuti klausa lengkap 'they didn't study...' dengan subject + verb. 'Because of' hanya diikuti noun phrase, dan 'in order to' digunakan untuk tujuan, bukan penyebab.

quiz.question: The manager scheduled additional training sessions ___ the team's poor performance in the last quarter.
quiz.explanation: 'Because of' benar karena diikuti noun phrase 'the team's poor performance...'. Ini menyatakan penyebab dengan struktur noun phrase. 'Because' memerlukan klausa (subject + verb), dan 'so that' digunakan untuk menyatakan tujuan.
